summary: Hiker suffered multiple serious injuries in a fall on South Maroon Bell at ~12,500 ft; a HAATS Black Hawk hoisted him off the mountain on a litter to Aspen Airport.
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen, Flight for Life, HAATS (CO Army National Guard)
notes: Rescued the same evening as the separate 2012-08-25 Hagerman rockslide; the civilian helicopter lacked a hoist, so the Black Hawk extracted the patient on a litter. Merge run 529: military.com 2012-09-07 HAATS article appended — same South Maroon Bell fall; article's second incident (same Black Hawk crew, ~7:15 p.m. call).
